propositions: Current clarity_score rewards volume and legacy type-specific shape rather than enforcing the authored plan-writing contract of grounded Context/Problem, Scope, and Approach sections.
The clarity measure is duplicated across gates.py and det_floor.py, creating drift risk when extending deterministic checks.

Plan-writing guidance and deterministic plan-review criteria are misaligned: author guide requires rejected alternatives while G6 explicitly forbids requiring them, and Success Criteria heading is documented but inert.
Deterministic AC verification coverage cannot be added without parsing checkbox items for proof clauses or attested markers, enabling per-check evidence reporting.
Placeholder and filler language in Scope/Approach (TBD, figure out, verify whether, etc.) should mechanically cap clarity when detected, independent of content length.
Required-section applicability differs by graph altitude: leaf plans need Approach and Scope, container plans need child decomposition—shape cannot be keyed on ticket type alone.
